# Recorded `bitbake -e` output

`bitbake-e-curl.out` is a trimmed copy of the output of

```sh
cd {{LIVE}}/yocto-kiss
env -u NETRC_FILE ../venv/bin/kas shell kas/kiss.yaml:kas/dogbonedark.yaml -c 'bitbake -e curl'
```

recorded on 2026-11-17 by `scripts/live-env.sh --verify` in the live environment
(`docs/live-environment.md`), stdout and stderr together, as `runs/bitbake-e-curl.out`
(27,246 lines, 1.9 MB). Versions: kas 5.5, BitBake 2.18.0 (bitbake
`6e260eb6ab1631607ea414d9ff8ede1155faa5d9`), openembedded-core
`33a6bd6cc8a9a976902081642414bd67adc74879`, meta-arm
`673e8d7c5dcd14de58092eb73e6ecc5eee5c1735`, yocto-kiss
`cc621c5d5725a51af9abb7b0d531cf6f9264a468`, all `wrynose`; `MACHINE = "dogbonedark"`,
`DISTRO = "kiss"`. Host: Arch-based ("EndeavourOS rolling"), Python 3.14.

What was kept, unchanged apart from the path replacement:

- the 17 lines before the dump: ten kas log lines (`<date> - INFO - ...`) and seven from
  the cooker (`NOTE: Reconnecting to bitbake server...`, `Loading cache...done.`,
  `Parsing recipes...done.`, `NOTE: Resolving any missing task queue dependencies`, ...);
- the whole include history (77 files);
- 50 variable blocks: `ABIEXTENSION`, `ABIEXTENSION:class-crosssdk`, `ALLOW_EMPTY` (no
  value printed), `ALLOW_EMPTY:curl-dbg`, `ALTERNATIVE` (one flag operation, no value),
  `AR` (exported), `ARMPKGARCH` (97 operations), `B`, `BBLAYERS`, `BPN`, `CC`, `CFLAGS`,
  `COMMON_PACKAGECONFIG`, `D`, `DEPENDS`, `DISTRO`, `DISTROOVERRIDES`, `EXTRA_OECONF`,
  `EXTRA_OEMAKE`, `FILES:curl`, `FILE_LAYERNAME`, `INHERIT`, `LICENSE`,
  `LIC_FILES_CHKSUM`, `MACHINE`, `MACHINEOVERRIDES`, `OVERRIDES`, `PACKAGECONFIG` (flags),
  `PACKAGECONFIG_CONFARGS`, `PACKAGES`, `PF`, `PN`, `PR`,
  `PREFERRED_PROVIDER_virtual/kernel`, `PTESTS_FAST` (`:remove[...]`), `PV`, `PWD`
  (exported), `RDEPENDS:curl-ptest`, `S`, `SHELL` (unexported: `unset SHELL`), `SRCREV`,
  `SRC_URI`, `SUMMARY`, `T`, `T:task-clean`, `THISDIR`, `TMPDIR`, `TOPDIR`, `WORKDIR`,
  `systemd_unitdir` (exported);
- six functions: shell `autotools_do_compile`, `do_compile` (`file: autogenerated`),
  `do_compile_ptest`; python `autotools_sitefiles`, `base_do_fetch`, `write_task_data`
  (the last block of the output).

Each cut is marked by one line `# [fixture] N lines cut` (45 of them); the parser counts
them as unrecognised lines. Blocks are cut whole: a kept block is byte-for-byte the
recorded one.

The absolute path of the live directory (`/home/<user>/Development/sous-chef-live`) is
replaced with `{{LIVE}}` everywhere; tests substitute a temporary directory
(`tests/envdump_support/mod.rs`). Blocks that held other personal data (`SSH_AUTH_SOCK`,
`LOGNAME`, `HOME`, and the anonymous python functions, whose names encode the home path)
were not kept. The trimming script refused to write output that still named the user.
